summary: Owned docs use mcp.json command node with args [absolute path to dist/index.js]; four single-mode pairs live under docs/config/.
details: Issue #51 / branch j1-t10/docs-node-config. Documented consumer launch is command node + args [/absolute/path/to/xq-jewy/dist/index.js] after npm run build. docs/config/ holds four single-mode mcp.json + YAML pairs: stubs-only, rest-only, assertions-only, reporting-only. Do not reintroduce uvx or Python toolchain launch forms in owned docs.
